target: Anclaje geográfico del ramal B del Paso de las Lajas.
art_direction: SUBJECT TYPE: LOCATION / ENVIRONMENT / LANDSCAPE — NO CREATURE. Camino estrecho que parece terminar ante una pared con caída lateral. No revelar acceso alterno ni explicar si continúa.
prompt: SUBJECT TYPE: LOCATION / ENVIRONMENT / LANDSCAPE — NO CREATURE. Create a wide landscape of Cornisa Ciega. A narrow traversable ledge branches from the regional route and follows a steep rock face until it appears to terminate against an unbroken wall. Beside it, a visible lateral drop makes the dead end uncomfortable but believable. Composition must preserve ambiguity: it may simply end here. Cold mountain light, layered gray stone, sparse wind-pressed growth.
negative_constraints: No cave entrance, ladder, bridge or secret passage
Do not reveal whether the route continues
No ruins, markings, magic or treasure clues
No characters or creatures as focal subject
notes: Fiel al anclaje geográfico canónico. No definir interior, jefe, secreto ni mecánica.
